session-access: Signing in returns an access token and sets a refresh cookie
Remember me decides how long the session lasts
Wrong credentials and unverified accounts are refused without leaking account state
Refreshing issues a new access token while the session is alive
Signing out ends only the current session and always succeeds
Signing in again starts a new session and leaves the old one alone
Everything outside sign-up, sign-in and the docs requires a valid access token
account-registration: A person registers with name, email, password and SpaceTraders account token
api-error-contract: Every response from the back's own endpoints is an envelope
Failures answered inside the firewall use the same envelope

FR-001.title: A verified person signs in with email and password and gets a 15-minute access token

FR-002.title: The refresh token comes only in a protected cookie, never in the body

FR-003.title: Remember me: 30-day persistent session; otherwise browser session capped at 24 hours

FR-004.title: A non-boolean remember me is refused with 400 http_error before credentials are checked

FR-005.title: Wrong password and unknown email get the same 401 invalid_credentials

FR-006.title: An unverified account gets 403 email_not_verified only with the right password

FR-008.title: Refresh returns a new access token without a new cookie or a longer session

FR-009.title: A missing, unknown, expired or revoked refresh cookie gets 401 invalid_refresh_token and is cleared

FR-010.title: Sign-out ends only the current session, clears the cookie and always answers 204

FR-011.title: Each sign-in starts a new session and leaves existing ones working

FR-012.title: Non-public routes require a valid access token and refuse others with the same 401 authentication_required

FR-013.title: Every error uses the standard error envelope, including firewall-decided ones
